guides.description: Step-by-step guides to generate production-ready codebases with StackInit — from Laravel APIs to full-stack Next.js apps.

routes.title: API Routes & Controllers
routes.subtitle: Control which components are generated for each model.

routes.tooltipController: Generates a CRUD controller with HTTP handler methods (index, show, store, update, destroy).
routes.tooltipRoutes: Registers RESTful API routes for this model in the router (GET, POST, PUT/PATCH, DELETE).
routes.tooltipService: Generates a Service class with business logic, separating it from the controller layer.
routes.tooltipRepository: Generates a Repository class abstracting data access — useful for testing and swapping ORMs.
routes.tooltipTests: Generates unit/feature test files with example test cases for CRUD operations.
